attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 (RHEL 10) and configured its login sessions with an 8192 open-file limit and a 256-process limit via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf. Verified enforcement through a real login-style session (sudo -u appworker sh -lc 'ulimit -n; ulimit -u'). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a native reboot (shutdown -r now) whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until exec was available again, confirmed a changed boot_id, and re-verified the account and limits survived the restart.
